description: This file defines an AuditService class for recording and querying audit events, including methods for inserting audit logs into a database and retrieving them with filters.

classes.name: AuditService
classes.description: Service class for managing audit trail with methods to record and query audit events.

methods.name: record_event
methods.description: Records an audit event with details such as event type, entity info, actor info, result, and optional details, returning the generated audit event ID.

methods.name: query_events
methods.description: Retrieves a list of audit events filtered by entity type and ID, limited to a specified number.
